snippet.title: My game's first trailer - Rogue Stradale Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509590/Rogue_Stradale/

After many many years of work I am finally ready to announce this! Everything in this game was designed and made entirely by me (with the exception of a handful of visual assets like textures and the trailer song). No gen-AI was used for any aspect of development.

I will be posting more videos soon!












#indiegame #racinggames #steamgames
